content: 1. Locate the login link situated in the upper right corner of the webpage. 2. Input the required details, including your full name. 3. Select the option labeled ‘create new account’ to proceed. 4. Upon successful account creation, you will receive a confirmation email verifying your registration with WikiDoc. 5. This guarantees that your name will be displayed on the history page, attributing credit to you for your edits or additions. 6. If you fail to log in before contributing, your IP address will be displayed in place of your name, and you will not receive proper credit for your work.
